notes: §13 sector (right): window of room 207 in flat 6-6A (1st floor, sill ≈124.0 m a.s.l.) faces north. In its 60° sector: obstacle at the plot-10/2 line may rise only ≈13 m (below the MPZP 18 m minimum → must stay OPEN); a 22 m wing is allowed from ≥8.55 m; the tower (>35 m) from ≥17.5 m — zone A's south edge is ≈20 m away ✓.

Hence the south-east corner of the site becomes the service/garden court opening to Wybrzeże Słowackiego — light for No. 5, delivery & garage access from the boulevard (allowed street), bike entry from the courtyard as the programme requires.
Mazowiecka 19: bathroom windows in the gable to be bricked up (client's accompanying works) → our west wing can abut the gable, closing the street frontage as heritage requires.
Dendrology: 44 trees + 51 shrub groups, none protected species; keep-class map prepared (Z1 priority maples in the gardens) → garden court keeps the best group.
Geotech: groundwater 3.2–3.8 m below ground, rubble fill up to 3.8 m → one tight basement level (+ partial second) is the rational, budget-safe choice.
